court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

judges: Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.

opinions.text:
Montana’s motion for partial summary judgment granted in part and denied in part without prejudice in accordance with the Special Master’s First Interim Report, and Amadarko Petroleum’s motion for leave to intervene denied.
Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
[For earlier order herein, see, e. g., ante, p. 958.]
